item.title: Geosql: A Claude/Codex skill for geospatial data
item.description:
📝 Quick Start With Python (interactive mode): pip install geosql && geosql Install directly into a supported agent: geosql install claude geosql install codex geosql install copilot Or in Claude Code: /plugin marketplace add dekart-xyz/geosql /plugin install geosql After geosql install copilot, use GeoSQL from VS Code Copilot or Copilot CLI with prompts such as: /geosql Show EV charger density along major roads and render a map Install Dekart for map rendering and PostGIS support GeoSQL optionally uses Dekart: an open-source Kepler. How it works GeoSQL runs an agent loop with a map in it. Benchmarks GeoSQL ships with a reproducible eval suite under evals/.
🔗 Read more: https://github.com/dekart-xyz/geosql
